newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Jurong Engineering wins work over S$40 mln.
newsitem.headline: Jurong Engineering wins work over S$40 mln.

text.p: Jurong Engineering Ltd said on Wednesday it had won additional contracts in Thailand, Malaysia and Indonesia worth more than Singapore $40 million.
It said in a statement its unit PT Jurong Engineering Lestari was currently working on a boiler construction project in Indonesia worth S$44 million.
It has now received a further order for building a steam turbine generator including piping prefabrication.
Thai Jurong Engineering Ltd, also a subsidiary, will be working on a power project in Map Ta Phut, Thailand.
